{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e643eb49.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Full-width rows and full-height columns of a non-background color are dividers.
    row_divs = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1:
                count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
                regions.append((count, r0, r1, c0, c1))
    if not regions:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(regions)
    template = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        for r in range(r0, r1):
            for c in range(c0, c1):
                out[r][c] = template[(r - r0) % len(template)][(c - c0) % len(template[0])]
    return out
"
